SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT_PROOF.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PAYMENT_PROOF ( PAYMENT_PROOF_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, PAY_MONTH, ROUND_NO, AMOUNT, PAY_DATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{paymentProofId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{payMonth}, #{roundNo}, #{amount}, #{payDate}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_PROOF_ID AS paymentProofId, GROUP_ID AS groupId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, PAY_MONTH AS payMonth, ROUND_NO AS roundNo, RESUBMIT_COUNT AS resubmitCount, STATUS AS status FROM PAYMENT_PROOF WHERE PAYMENT_PROOF_ID = #{proofId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT_PROOF SET STATUS = #{status}, REVIEWED_BY = #{reviewedBy}, REVIEWED_AT = SYSDATE, REVIEW_MEMO = #{reviewMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PAYMENT_PROOF_ID = #{proofId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE PAYMENT_PROOF SET STATUS = 'PENDING', PAY_DATE = #{payDate}, RESUBMIT_COUNT = RESUBMIT_COUNT + 1 WHERE PAYMENT_PROOF_ID = #{proofId} AND STATUS = 'REVISION'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION n JOIN PAYMENT_PROOF p ON p.PAYMENT_PROOF_ID = n.REF_ID WHERE n.MEMBER_ID = #{ownerId} AND n.NOTIF_TYPE = 'PROOF_PENDING' AND p.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND n.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
